source_sha_role: v8 ops baseline before visible Facebook/Instagram depth layer
source_sha_policy: Cloudflare GitHub App deploys every main push directly to Pages; GitHub Actions workflows are manual fallback/verification paths.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; duplicate URLs collapse at runtime; private, minor, legal, financial and quarantined records are excluded from the public universe.

social_corpus.default_projection: non-archive public-life records; civic/political records remain available as neutral public archive
social_corpus.policy: Person before platform; source-linked public material; public comments are short, source-verifiable and name-suppressed in projection; mixed response is preserved; metrics require a dated source.

release_intent: Make Facebook and Instagram materially visible on the homepage with twelve source-linked posts, verified metrics and short public audience excerpts, in addition to the 52-item corpus.
promotion_gate: Cloudflare GitHub App check must succeed and 7ya.io must serve the v8 marker plus the 52-item social corpus.
rollback: Prior Git commits and the last valid AppDeploy version remain available as rollback references; production routing must not use an AppDeploy catch-all proxy.

operations.github_actions_role: manual fallback / optional verification while runner billing is unavailable
operations.cache_policy: homepage and social corpus revalidate/no-store; social JS/CSS cache-busted at v8
